ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Splits ci.yml's single test job into two parallel test jobs (tests-shared, tests-main) plus the existing required check python-checks as gather job; adds actions/download-artifact@v7 (GitHub-owned, mutable major tag per the standing pinning decision; upload-artifact@v7 was already used) for same-run hand-off between jobs. Top-level token stays contents: read, no secret or permission added, no third-party action added or re-pinned (setup-uv stays SHA-pinned). Required check name 'Python (lint + test)' unchanged; python-checks fails closed when a needed job is not success. Does not widen the trust boundary.
